::: {#exr-weight-decay-sweep}

#### Choosing the weight decay

Which `weight_decay` among 0, $10^{-4}$, $10^{-3}$, $10^{-2}$ and $10^{-1}$,
passed to the [Adam](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-adam) of `fit()`,
gives `make_net()` the lowest validation loss after 300 [epochs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch)?

:::
